$comment: Vitest transpiles test files with esbuild as ES modules, so top-level `await import(...)` -- the idiom that installs vi.mock()s before the module under test is loaded -- is legal at runtime. Under the CommonJS `module` the app itself is built with, tsc rejects it (TS1378), so the tests are type-checked as ESM here instead. Run by `npm run typecheck` alongside the app config.
